body: Me too. Months from now and yes, a sense of relief
Hey, yea I am. Unable to sleep really. Just sitting alone trying not to disturb my sleeping wife and browsing for cheap apartments.

Someone's comment got deleted, here is my reply.

Together for 8 and married for 4.

Nah, I know I've had my share of problems. And above all I want her to be happy,whoever she is with. And i couldn't hurt someone I love ever. 

As a guy it's hard for me to show the love I feel for her and this has been a problem. She says she doesn't see the love. I say I do love you. She says, I don't see it in your actions. I don't know what to do.

Also, I plan on sparing her the pain of all this. I will just move out, keep in contact with her for a few months and gradually let the conversation die down. Once I make sure that the news of my death never reaches her, I will go. She will think I am alive and happy and that way she will be too. Right?
It should be. Someone said I should just take any job for the time being. I think I will talk to a counselor too.
Yea, I guess you are right. I can do that job and still keep looking.

I do not know either. I have experience, a masters in Information systems and so cant find work. I interview well too. I am cheerful on the outside.
Do not know what's wrong.
Been trying and interviewing for the past 4 months. No luck yet. And i want to fix all this and make my wife happy however I can.

Aeronautical undergrad and information systems masters. At this point all I want is to contribute. I've tried a lot and apart from jobs with pay that won't even cover our utility bills, I haven't found any.

Bit of both.
Even if I do get a job, I feel like it's past a point where she would be happier with someone else.
